title: Federal preemption.
bodyText: Part IV of this chapter shall be deemed repealed if a federal law or a combination of federal laws takes effect that establishes a national program for the recycling of electronic devices that substantially meets the intent of part IV of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §339D-12  Federal preemption.  Part IV of this chapter shall be deemed repealed if a federal law or a combination of federal laws takes effect that establishes a national program for the recycling of electronic devices that substantially meets the intent of part IV of this chapter. [L Sp 2008, c 13, pt of §2; am L 2009, c 183, §15; am L 2022, c 151, §8]
